target_customer: Small and medium businesses in India (retailers, distributors, freelancers, service providers) that need GST invoicing and payment collection
problem: Small Indian businesses need simple GST-compliant billing, invoice sharing and payment collection without complex accounting software.
business_model: Freemium SaaS; free mobile app with limited features and paid desktop plans of INR 1,299 to 2,499 as of February 2022 (Inc42)
product_category: SMB billing, invoicing and accounting software (India)

founders.name: Aditya Vemuganti
founders.background_notes: Inc42 says the two founders were executives at Amazon and Great Learning; which employer belongs to which founder is not stated in the opened sources.

founders.name: Sri Teja Allaparthi
founders.background_notes: See Aditya Vemuganti; education not found.

competitors.name: myBillBook (FloBiz)
competitors.what: GST billing and accounting app for small businesses
competitors.traction_then: 10 million plus users per Inc42, February 2022

competitors.name: Vyapar
competitors.what: GST billing and inventory app backed by IndiaMART
competitors.traction_then: 3 million plus users per Inc42, February 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: GST invoicing, WhatsApp sharing and payment links are mostly standard SaaS with Indian tax compliance requirements.

defensibility.rationale: Established rivals already had millions of users and billing data creates modest switching costs, so differentiation depended on WhatsApp-first design.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were already building the same wedge before the batch; no source shows them acquiring Swipe.

market_need_then: India's SMBs were adopting GST invoicing and WhatsApp commerce; Inc42 cited rivals at millions of users, showing established demand, while Swipe had about 10K dollars ARR in early 2022.

branding.domain_note: Uses getswipe.in, a get-prefixed Indian domain; no purchase history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Upbeat and simple, for example Create invoices for free in 10 seconds and Inventory so simple, it feels like magic

brand_strength.rationale: Site claims 2.5 million plus businesses but the name Swipe is generic and confusable with other payment products, and no press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Swipe joined YC Summer 2021 as a WhatsApp invoicing app for Indian SMBs, raised a 2 million dollar seed led by YC in February 2022 and now claims over 2.5 million businesses and a team of 60. It is Active with no exit. Revenue figures for fiscal 2024 and 2025 are unverified. It entered a crowded market with myBillBook and Vyapar far ahead, so success relied on freemium growth and WhatsApp distribution.
notes: Seed confirmed by Inc42 (February 11, 2022) and Venture Intelligence (February 14, 2022); lists differ slightly (Inc42 names Lish and Oliver Jung, VI names K3 Diversity Ventures). Competitor sources are dated February 2022, about five months after the Summer 2021 batch, and rivals existed earlier but no pre-batch dated source was opened. The YourStory piece of December 2021 and the company seed blog were blocked or missing and not used. Revenue of 3.1 and 5.8 crore rupees for FY24 and FY25 is from one secondary source and not recorded. The YC page headline now reads Super AI Accountant for SMBs. A Caplight banner about a 16M Series A is unrelated and ignored.
